title: .eser/manifest.yml
description: Schema for the .eser/manifest.yml project file: the workflows and scripts the eser CLI runs, and the settings noskills keeps.

stack.description: Languages and runtimes the project uses (for example "javascript", "golang").

workflows.description: Workflows the eser CLI runs on events such as precommit.

scripts.description: Named commands run with `eser <name>`: a command string, or an object with the command and its settings.

exports.description: Module exports a laroux runtime app manifest lists.

noskills.description: The noskills section, written by `noskills init` (pkg/@eserstack/noskills state/persistence.ts, Go noskillsfx/persistence.go).

concerns.description: List of concern IDs from .eser/concerns/ to apply to all specs.

tools.description: Coding assistant tools available in this project.

project.description: Detected tech-stack traits for this project.

maxIterationsBeforeRestart.description: Maximum Claude iterations in one turn before prompting a context reset. 0 means unlimited.

verifyCommand.description: Shell command run after each execution turn to verify correctness (e.g. "node --run test").

allowGit.description: Whether Claude is permitted to run destructive git write commands (commit, push, checkout --). Defaults to false for safety.

command.description: Custom shell command used to launch the coding assistant (overrides the tool default). Leave empty to use the tool default.

user.description: Per-user identity, used in spec metadata (contributors, approvals).

defaultReviewPosture.description: Controls how the spec refinement phase expands or contracts scope.

validate.description: Turns on cross-model validation of the end of discovery and the spec proposal, and names the agent that runs it.

agent.description: An @eserstack/ai provider name, such as claude-code or anthropic.

model.description: The model id that provider runs.

workflow.description: An ordered list of steps and the events that run them.

on.description: Events that run the workflow (precommit, prepush, commitmsg, preflight, ...).

includes.description: Ids of workflows whose steps run before this one's.

step.description: A tool name, or a map from one tool name to its options.

stepOptions.description: The tool's options, plus the engine directives below, which the engine keeps and the tool never sees.

continueOnError.description: Report a failing tool as a failed step instead of stopping the workflow.

if.description: An Expr predicate; the step runs only when it is true.

bypass.description: Skip the tool; the step's output is the previous step's stats.

loop.description: Run the step once per element of a collection.

over.description: An Expr expression that gives the collection.

as.description: The option name that holds the current element.

asIndex.description: The option name that holds the current index.

inputSchema.description: A JSON Schema the merged options must match before the tool runs.
